name: alphaai-sample
description: AlphaAI seed corpus: a small, hand-written instruction/response set used to verify the AlphaAI training foundation end to end (record schema, dedupe, split, tokenizer training, reference training loop, evaluation).
notes: This is a starter corpus for pipeline verification, not a pretraining dataset. It contains no text from other models; every line was written for AlphaAI. Replace it with your own data (keeping dataset.json + manifest.json) for real training.
